sharedRules.name: Paymaster
sharedRules.description: Free Company armies must include a model with Paymaster. The Paymaster gains Battle Standard Bearer, but cannot take any Banner Enchantments. Any unit joined by the Paymaster gains Bodyguard (Paymaster). At the end of a phase in which the Paymaster is removed as a casualty, all friendly unengaged units must test for Panic at -1 Discipline. Free Company Armies do not award extra VP for Defeated General or Defeated Battle Standard Bearer. Instead, 400 VPs are awarded if the Paymaster was removed as a casualty.

sharedRules.name: Contracts
sharedRules.description:
Provided the Paymaster is on the battlefield, some friendly models in the army gain a bonus depending on the agreed upon Secondary Objective:
1. Hold the Ground - Friendly Scoring units gain Battle Focus while within 6” of the center of the board.
2. Breakthrough - Friendly Scoring units gain +2 March rate.
3. Spoils of War - Rolls for Charge Range against enemy units carrying an Objective Marker are subject to Maximized Roll.
4. King of the Hill - Friendly units gain Hatred against enemy units partially within either objective.
5. Capture the Flags - Friendly marked units must reroll failed Panic checks.
6. Secure Target - Friendly Scoring units within 6” of the center of a marker gain +1 Discipline.

If no Secondary Objective is chosen, or if alternative Secondary Objectives are being utilized, apply the bonus rules for Breakthrough. All bonuses immediately cease if the Paymaster is removed as a casualty.
